bestBets.overview: ANOTHER NEPHEW will find this easier than last 2 starts and can improve sharply. BIG SHOTS mixes form but best is good enough. AWESOME LILY wouldn't totally shock if can find best. FRIES WITH THAT won well latest and can go on with it here. SPACE ACE next best.

raceTips.comment:
ANOTHER NEPHEW is the class runner here and won with 60kg three starts back. Expect Jason Li to go forward, use the extra fitness dropping from two staying trips and kick on straightening. FRIES WITH THAT will get the gun run behind and was able to do exactly the same last start. Tash stays on. Think this is a race in 2.
The difference between AWESOME LILY's best and worse is about 15 lengths. Who knows what version turns up. 
BIG SHOTS has to be a query with 59kg over the 1750m.

formRaceEntries.commentStewards: Raced wide throughout. Lay inwards in the straight.

bestBets.overview: CRUISE TO VICTORY has won 3 of last 5 starts and must be rated highly. PRINCE RAGNAR did enough fresh to suggest he can be more than competitive here 2nd up. RED REBEL is a consistent type who will make presence felt as usual. FIRE THE GUARD wasn't beaten far latest and will only need to hold form to go close again. WEAPONS HOT mixes form but best is good enough.

raceTips.comment:
CRUISE TO VICTORY had an outstanding Broome season but when trying to go with Broome Sprint Winner in Now You See Me he simply got blown up. 32 day freshen would have done the world of good. Look for him to go forward and be hard to catch.
FIRE THE GUARD carries 10kg less and can kick through on the fence.
GALAXY AFFAIR will also carry another big weight but has been doing it all season.
RED REBEL is consistent as ever but 1700 back to 1200 is a big query.

bestBets.overview: MAGIC CARATS gets a soft run from gate 1 and will be in this a long way. COSTA STAR wasn't beaten far latest and will only need to hold for to go close again. COUPE DEBURJ broke maiden status latest and can go on with it here. DEMETRIOUS will find this easier than past couple and can improve sharply. HOT NOVA wouldn't shock if can find best.

raceTips.comment:
COUPE DEBURJ earned that maiden win last start and walked in. This isnt much harder. Expecting Amy to keep her wide and build into the race.
MAGIC CARATS has returned very well - in particular beating home Tango Rhythm first up. Not disgraced in a 56+ last start.
COSTA STAR was good in this grade at Junction - from a low gate and Giann's claim she can go close again.
DASHING DIVA ran a huge odds two starts back and a repeat of that performance would see her up to this.

bestBets.overview: SHOOTING KONTIKI is a consistent type who will make presence felt as usual. KIMBERLEY CURRENCY off back to back placings must be rated highly. COONDLE will be in this a long way from the gate and must be respected. CITY OF SIN is having first run for new stable and wouldn't shock. MARS MISSION must be respected on best form, keep safe.  LADY COCO looks the knockout hope.

raceTips.comment:
KIMBERLEY CURRENCY has had an amazingly consistent preparation. Maps well, love the claim and this isn't a strong 56+
SHOOTING KONTIKI gets Tash in the saddle and has gone close in this grade at his last few starts. B8 will require a nice ride here.
COONDLE has the option to lead from B1 and that could take him a long way today.
SMART RETURN was a great maiden win three starts back but hasnt been able to replicate that win since.

bestBets.overview: ZADAR ROCK off back to back placings must be rated highly on current form. DYNAMIC ONE well latest and can go on with it here. KINGS SICARIO off 3 straight wins will prove hard to beat again. STAR TESTYMONY broke through for overdue win latest and wouldn't shock. CANDLELIGHT SHERIF next best.

raceTips.comment:
Great edition of the Carnarvon Cup here and here's hoping that ZADAR ROCK can go out on top. He gets2kg on KINGS SICARIO for being beaten a length in the Broome Cup. He's a marvel and with the expected hot tempo that'll suit him to the tee. Fairytale here we come.
STAR TESTYMONY deserved the win last start in the Peter Evans last start. Has improved since the Port Hedland Cup and is a big chance in this.
KINGS SICARIO has won his last three on the bounce. Your reigning Broome Cup winner and no reason he cant win this one.
CANDLELIGHT SHERIF hasn't put in a bad run all season.

bestBets.overview: SOLAR SYSTEM off back to back wins must be rated highly. KEYTRADE is knocking on the door and is due for a change of luck. IRONCLAD BOY broke through for overdue win latest and can go on with it here. WESTERN IMPACT mixes form but best is good enough. TANGO RHYTHM is coming off 3 straight wins and will prove hard to beat again. SHE IS ALL MAGIC wouldn't totaly shock on best.

raceTips.comment:
TANGO RHYTHM owes me nothing having won his last three on the  bounce in impressive fashion. No reason she cant do it again from the nice gate.
SOLAR SYSTEM was good last start when going 1600 back to the 1200 and dead-heated with IRONCLAD BOY. He's been gong well all season.
SOARING SOLO is your likely leader and 1200m might be what she's after in this last race for the season.
